```{r}
#| output: asis
# Reads jeopardy.csv (category, value, question, answer, choices, optional image URL) and embeds it
clues <- read.csv("jeopardy.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("<script>const CLUES = ", jsonlite::toJSON(clues, na = "null"), ";</script>")
```

```{=html}
<div id="jp-teams"></div>
<div id="jp-board"></div>

<div id="jp-modal" hidden>
  <div class="jp-card">
    <div id="jp-value"></div>
    <div id="jp-q"></div>
    <img id="jp-img" alt="" hidden>
    <ol id="jp-choices" type="A"></ol>
    <div id="jp-a" hidden></div>
    <div class="jp-controls">
      <button id="jp-show">Show answer</button>
      <div id="jp-award"></div>
      <button id="jp-close">Done</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  :root { --jp-blue: #060ce9; --jp-gold: #ffcc00; }
  #jp-teams { display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .jp-team { text-align: center; }
  .jp-team input { width: 9rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; }
  .jp-score { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; }
  #jp-board { display: grid; gap: 6px; background: #000; padding: 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
  .jp-cat, .jp-cell { background: var(--jp-blue); color: #fff; text-align: center;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 80px;
    padding: .5rem; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; }
  .jp-cell { color: var(--jp-gold); font-size: 2rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; }
  .jp-cell:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.3); }
  .jp-cell:disabled { cursor: default; }
  #jp-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.85); z-index: 2000;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  #jp-modal[hidden] { display: none; }
  .jp-card { background: var(--jp-blue); color: #fff; width: min(900px, 92vw);
    padding: 2rem; border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; }
  #jp-value { color: var(--jp-gold); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  #jp-q { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  #jp-img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 40vh; margin: 0 auto 1rem; display: block; border-radius: 4px; }
  #jp-img[hidden] { display: none; }
  #jp-choices { text-align: left; display: inline-block; font-size: 1.2rem; }
  #jp-a { color: var(--jp-gold); font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 1rem 0; }
  .jp-controls { display: flex; gap: .75rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 1rem; }
  .jp-controls button { background: var(--jp-gold); color: #000; border: none; padding: .4rem .9rem;
    border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
  #jp-award button.minus { background: #ddd; }
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  const SHOW_CHOICES = true;          // false = classic Jeopardy (no multiple choice)
  const N_TEAMS = 3;

  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const teams = Array.from({ length: N_TEAMS }, (_, i) => ({ name: `Team ${i + 1}`, score: 0 }));
  const cats = [...new Set(CLUES.map(c => c.category))];
  const vals = [...new Set(CLUES.map(c => +c.value))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  let current = null;

  // --- scoreboard ---
  function renderTeams() {
    $("jp-teams").innerHTML = "";
    teams.forEach(t => {
      const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "jp-team";
      const n = document.createElement("input"); n.value = t.name;
      n.oninput = e => { t.name = e.target.value; };
      const s = document.createElement("div"); s.className = "jp-score"; s.textContent = t.score;
      d.append(n, s); $("jp-teams").append(d);
    });
  }

  // --- board ---
  const board = $("jp-board");
  board.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cats.length}, 1fr)`;
  cats.forEach(c => {
    const h = document.createElement("div"); h.className = "jp-cat"; h.textContent = c; board.append(h);
  });
  vals.forEach(v => cats.forEach(cat => {
    const clue = CLUES.find(c => c.category === cat && +c.value === v);
    const cell = document.createElement("button"); cell.className = "jp-cell";
    if (clue) { cell.textContent = v; cell.onclick = () => openClue(clue, cell); }
    else cell.disabled = true;
    board.append(cell);
  }));

  // --- clue view ---
  function openClue(clue, cell) {
    current = { clue, cell };
    $("jp-value").textContent = `${clue.category} · ${clue.value}`;
    $("jp-q").textContent = clue.question;
    const img = $("jp-img");
    if (clue.image) { img.src = clue.image; img.hidden = false; } else { img.removeAttribute("src"); img.hidden = true; }
    const ch = $("jp-choices"); ch.innerHTML = "";
    if (SHOW_CHOICES) (clue.choices || "").split(" | ").filter(Boolean).forEach(x => {
      const li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = x; ch.append(li);
    });
    $("jp-a").textContent = clue.answer; $("jp-a").hidden = true;
    const aw = $("jp-award"); aw.innerHTML = "";
    teams.forEach(t => {
      const plus = document.createElement("button"); plus.textContent = `+ ${t.name}`;
      plus.onclick = () => { t.score += +clue.value; renderTeams(); };
      const minus = document.createElement("button"); minus.textContent = `− ${t.name}`;
      minus.className = "minus"; minus.onclick = () => { t.score -= +clue.value; renderTeams(); };
      aw.append(plus, minus);
    });
    $("jp-modal").hidden = false;
  }
  $("jp-show").onclick = () => { $("jp-a").hidden = false; };
  $("jp-close").onclick = () => {
    current.cell.textContent = ""; current.cell.disabled = true;
    $("jp-modal").hidden = true;
  };

  renderTeams();
})();
</script>
```
